description: Real data: ENCODE CTCF ChIP-seq in K562 (ENCSR000BPJ, Myers lab; file ENCFF582SNT, IDR thresholded peaks, GRCh38), the 1000 strongest peaks by signal. CTCF is an insulator protein that binds a strong, well-defined motif at TAD boundaries and loop anchors, mostly at distal and intergenic sites. We expect the CTCF motif to dominate and co-binding with cohesin (RAD21, SMC3). Use this set to check motif enrichment and public co-binding against a known answer.
